common_name: Incrediball Storm Proof Hydrangea (Sturdy-Stemmed Giant White Smooth Hydrangea)

planting.note: Plant container shrubs in spring or fall in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in full sun to partial shade; Incrediball Storm Proof was bred from the original Incrediball specifically for thicker, more rigid stems that keep its oversized blooms upright after heavy rain.

directions: Incrediball Storm Proof improves on the original Incrediball by packing the same enormous rounded white flower clusters onto noticeably thicker, more rigid stems, so the heavy blooms stay upright through summer thunderstorms instead of flopping to the ground. It flowers on new wood each year, so a hard late-winter pruning back to a foot or so above the ground still produces a full flush of blooms the same season. Plant in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil with full sun in cooler climates or afternoon shade where summers are hot, since the broad flower heads can wilt in intense direct sun. Keep soil consistently moist throughout summer, as the large leaves and flower clusters draw heavily on water during bloom.
